title: Claude Desktop Fake configuration, schema 3
description: Windows process-local virtualization. UTC clock shift, time-zone bias, formatting, UI language and home region are separate settings. Windows validates installed time zones and NLS data at initialization.

enabled.description: Enable virtual UTC and the configured time zone.

timeZoneId.description: An installed Windows time-zone ID. Pacific Standard Time includes automatic seasonal DST; do not replace it with an IANA ID.

utcOffsetSeconds.description: Additional UTC CLOCK SHIFT in seconds, NOT the time-zone offset. Virtual UTC = real UTC + this value. Keep 0 for the correct current time in Los Angeles; DST and UTC-7/UTC-8 come from timeZoneId. This is required, not a placeholder or auto-detect sentinel. The native validator also checks the resulting date range.

formatLocale.description: Concrete Windows NLS locale for default date, number and currency formatting.

uiLanguage.description: Concrete UI language, independent of formatLocale and homeRegion; does not translate resource text.

homeRegion.description: Concrete ISO two-letter country/region recognized by Windows NLS. Independent of language, time zone and IP address.

unknownVersionPolicy.description: Compatibility policy for identity-matched managed Claude: block unsupported runtime adaptation, or roll back and pass through all virtualization.

captureEnabled.description: Optional bounded, in-memory diagnostic samples of Date, Intl, navigator and timing values in naturally created JS contexts. Read with Capture-Runtime.ps1. Not a logging, telemetry or packet-capture switch. Hook activation does not require capture. Enabling capture requires compatible sampling interfaces.
